source.name: Bed Bath & Beyond Inc. Amended and Restated Credit Agreement dated 2021-08-09 (Form 8-K Exhibit 10.1)
source.notes: Minimum operating liquidity = max(10% x $1,130.0mm ABL commitments, $95.0mm) = $113.0mm, the availability level below which the springing fixed-charge covenant applies (Section 6.14). Bed Bath & Beyond's FCCR was negative, so falling below it is a default trigger. Source: Filed 2021-08-10, accession 0000886158-21-000033. Section 6.14: the fixed charge coverage covenant springs when Availability is less than the greater of 10% of the Line Cap and $95,000,000. Applicable Rate grid: Eurodollar/term spread 1.75% when Average Quarterly Availability is below 33% of the Aggregate Revolving Commitment. Commitment fee 0.20%-0.25% on unused commitments; no fee is charged per draw. The 2022-08-31 amendment itself was filed only as scanned page images (10-Q Exhibit 4.1) and was not machine-read, so these 2021 terms are cited as the last text-readable version.
